summary: ClearSign Technologies filed an 8-K reporting the full exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option in connection with its May 2026 firm-commitment public offering. The underwriting agreement with Newbridge Securities involved an initial sale of 777,780 shares at $4.33 per share; on June 18, 2026, the underwriter purchased an additional 116,667 shares, yielding net proceeds of approximately $470,858. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital, R&D, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising disclosure, not a special situation.
